title: 10 Things a Godly Man Learns to Do With His Hands
caption:
Before Jesus preached a sermon, He spent years working with His hands.

A godly man is useful. Not because skills make him a man, but because a man who belongs to Christ wants to be someone people can count on. Learn one of these this month. Ask an older man to show you.

Save this and pick one to learn this weekend.
